pages.article_html:
Seadredge Doldrums

Level 30 · Adventuring · Sea of Mist

Objectives

Slay seadredges and kelpwalkers found around Aynien in the Lamprey Islands, then return to Aynien. - Seadredges (0/15) - Kelpwalkers (0/25)

Description

Aynien asks, "You say you have a teleporter?" "I'd like to have a good look at it before you try to use it on me. I don't want to end up lost in the ether." "Please keep the kelpwalkers and seadredges away from me while I examine this. They're horrible creatures who have beleaguered me during my entire time here, and their distractions will make it more difficult for me to figure out the teleporter."

What they say

On offering it

Aynien
You say you have a teleporter? I'd like to have a good look at it before you try to use it on me. I don't want to end up lost in the ether. Please keep the kelpwalkers and seadredges away from me while I examine this. They're horrible creatures who have beleaguered me during my entire time here, and their distractions will make it more difficult for me to figure out the teleporter.

Recorded by quest description.

Notes

Most of the seadredges are in the water. The kelpwalkers are found mostly on the island.

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

findings.observation: Objectives print Seadredges (0/15) and Kelpwalkers (0/25), with instructions to slay them around Aynien in the Lamprey Islands and return to Aynien. The alternative fandom account prints the same counts as Slain (15) and Slain (25). These agree as attributed counts, without establishing exact mob templates or kill-credit mechanics.

Starts with and Hand in to both name Aynien. Location prints -5935, -59451, 901 in Sea of Mist (-29, 29). This is a page contact-location observation, not independently verified spawn data or coordinate axes.

Notes place most seadredges in water and most kelpwalkers on the island. The attributed walkthrough in A Marvelous Plan describes both around level 30 3dot and land/water hunting. These qualitative accounts do not establish spawn tables, exact levels, respawn times or probabilities.

Description and offering dialogue attribute teleporter examination and a request to keep the creatures away to Aynien. Repeated wording in the offering section is marked Recorded by quest description; it is not independent corroboration or evidence of exact client dialogue triggers.

Header prints Level 30, Adventuring, Sea of Mist. Series Unicorn, Previous Finding Aynien and Next Unicorns Reunited are navigation observations. The prior Finding Aynien record reciprocally links this quest; enforced prerequisites and minimum eligibility remain unknown.

No Rewards section or amount appears on this quest page. The A Marvelous Plan walkthrough attributes teleporting Aynien after the 40 kills, then returning to Myrthion for a choice of Unicorn Mount colors. Retain those later-chain claims separately; do not assign a mount reward or teleport-use objective to Seadredge Doldrums.

Source field cites the archived MMODB page seadredge-doldrums-2912.html; the alternative objective account is labelled fandom. The cached archive aggregates these accounts. Archived mirrors share provenance and are not independent corroboration; no original page was downloaded during this review.

detail_observations.label: Description
detail_observations.text: Enorian says, "The device I'll give you is broken, probably because it was buried in Zoth Uluus' mud for centuries in the Leth Verael ruins." "I dug it up years ago, and cleaned it up some. I believe the unicorns of Leth Verael worked with the high elves to develop and use these devices. Perhaps they'd teleport unicorns across the city to get from one garden to another." "Regardless, I think Ardalan Awji can get this device working again. He lives in Mekalia, but in the mountains; not in the city."

detail_observations.label: Another account
detail_observations.text:
Walkthrough as recorded by vgwalkthroughs 1. The Broken Device
   Enorian Andowyn ends up giving you a teleportation device that is broken. He dug it up in the Leth Verael ruins a while back, and was broken when he found it. He tells you about a guy that he knows named Ardalan Awji, who lives in the mountains in Qalia, by the city of Mekalia. The fastest way there would be to take the riftway to Qa Riverbank, and head one chunk east on the back of a wyvern. Ardalan Awji is located in the mountains and should be easy to find, especially since you have a mark on your map that leads directly to him.
   When you make it to Ardalan Awji he instantly gives you a new Allegiance Saddlebag, which is a 22 slot saddlebag, and most likely will replace the one that you have on (woohoo, you can collect more junk now!).
   Quest: Question and Answer
   Ardalan Awji seems willing to fix the device for you, and says that it would be a challenge worthy of his wit. Unfortunately he needs Arcane Pliers to complete the job, but he doesn't have it to fix the device, but he does know somebody who does named Azeeta Shaheen. Now the tool costs 10 gold to get (yup GOLD!), so I hope you have a lot of cash to burn. Azeeta Shaheen is located one chunk south in the chunk of Zossyr Hakrel. Watch out for mobs as you run through this chunk as there are many mobs in the low 30s (2dot) that will attack you, but once you do make it to Azeeta Shaheen, it is just a matter of purchasing the Pliers and heading back to Ardalan Awji for the turn in.
2. The Device Works!
   Your Unicorn Teleporter is now in full working condition! All you have to do is right click the device to find the last remaining lost Unicorn. When you do right click it, a point on your map will appear on the northern portion of Thestra, of a unicorn by the name of Aynien.
   There is no easy way to travel to Aynien and the only way I can suggest would be to take the riftway to Three Rivers, and fly as far as you can go to Aynien (she is marked on your map. She is located three chunks to the north and two chunks to the west on a small island. When you get there, watch out for mobs that are also on the island.
3. The Last Unicorn
   When you make it to Aynien you inform her that you have a device that will teleport her away from this island. She is skeptical of the device and wants to examine it over before she uses it. While she is examining it she would like you to kill a few of the Seadredges and Kelpwalkers that lurk around the island, 15 Seadredges and 25 Kelpwalkers to be exact! Both mobs are around level 30 3dot and are not only wandering around the island, but are also wandering in the water. In fact there won't be enough mobs to kill on land, that you will be forced to either wait for respawn or find them in the water.
   After all 40 mobs are killed go back to Aynien where she agrees to use the Unicorn Teleporter. She has attuned the device to her and needs you to use the device on her so she can get teleported. She also tells you to return to Myrthion (the very first unicorn!) and explain to him that all the unicorns have been reunited!
   So you can right click the device on Aynien and start your long journey back to Myrthion. I recommend recalling back to civilization and taking your nearest riftway back to Silverlake. Take a Griffon from there and fly north until you reach Myrthion (he is marked on your map). You find Myrithion in the exact same place where you left him, and he is extremely excited that you have found all of the lost unicorns! In fact he is so excited that he offers you a Unicorn Mount! (FINALLY!)
   Now there will be a bunch of different Unicorns that you can choose from, each of them have the same stats and the only difference would be that they have different color saddles. Your choices of colors are Forest-Colored, Amber, Black, Sky-Colored, Green, and Blue. So pick your favorite color and there you have it, your very own Unicorn Mount! Now go gallop around the world on your glorious steed, and show off your new pet!
   Part 1 - Zar the "not-so" Mighty
   Required Level: 21The Unicorn Horn
   Part 2 - Adaenyl's Bidding
   Required Level: 23Aeokor Hunting
   Part 3 - Medratheda's Bidding
   Required Level: 24Let's Make Some Lizard Stew.
   Part 4 - The Shrine Divine
   Required Level: 25The Raging Brownies
   Protection from Ashendregs
   Look at the Size of That Bird!
   Part 5 - Wardship Troubles
   Required Level: 28Locating Another Unicorn
   Part 6 - Down the Last Stretch
   Required Level: 30The Broken Device http://www.vgwalkthroughs.com:80/page/parts/18
